title: Create a new website generation session
description: This verifies that an anonymous visitor can describe a site, configure prompt options, submit the form, and reach a live generation dashboard.

steps.description: Fill in the prompt field with a website description for a small business landing page
Verify a live session dashboard is displayed
Verify generation progress content is visible

title: Show authentication prompt when anonymous quota is exhausted
description: This verifies that an anonymous visitor who has no remaining generation quota is shown an authentication overlay instead of starting a new session.

steps.description: Fill in the prompt field with a website description for a portfolio site
Verify an authentication overlay is visible

title: View live generation progress on a session dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can open an existing session dashboard and inspect generation progress, logs, and the preview area.

steps.description: Verify generation progress logs are visible
Verify the preview area is visible

title: Start a Stripe checkout from the session export flow
description: A signed-in user can open the payment modal and start a Stripe checkout for premium export features.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the payment modal or checkout initiation is displayed

title: Download the exported site when eligible
description: A signed-in user can access the export flow and download the exported ZIP when export access is available.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the exported file download is initiated

title: See export targets and subscription status on a session
description: A signed-in user can view available export targets and subscription status on the session dashboard before exporting.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}

title: Refine a site through chat from the session dashboard
description: A user can send a chat message on the session dashboard and see the dashboard update with the refined result.

steps.description: Send a chat message to refine the generated site
Verify the dashboard shows the updated result after the chat message

title: Sign in with email from the top navigation
description: This verifies that a user can open the sign-in experience from the homepage and complete email sign-in to return in an authenticated state.

steps.description: Open the sign-in experience from the top navigation
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the signed-in account state is visible

title: Edit preview text inline and save changes
description: A user can open a preview, edit text inline, save the change, and see the updated content persist in the preview.

steps.description: Select an editable element in the preview
Edit the selected text with a new value
Verify the updated text is visible in the preview

title: Refresh the preview after generation updates
description: This verifies that a user can refresh the session preview and see the updated rendered site content.

steps.description: Verify the preview content is displayed
Verify updated preview information is visible

title: Edit preview styles and save changes
description: A user can change visual styling in the preview, save it, and see the updated appearance reflected on the page.

steps.description: Select an editable element in the preview
Edit a style property for the selected element
Verify the updated style is reflected in the preview

title: Sign out from the account menu
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can sign out and return to anonymous browsing from the homepage.

steps.description: Verify the user is returned to anonymous browsing

title: Restore an earlier preview version
description: A user can make a preview edit and then restore a previous version from history so the earlier content returns.

steps.description: Select an editable element in the preview
Edit the selected text with a new value
Restore an earlier version from history
Verify the previous content is visible again in the preview

title: Toggle the session preview size
description: This verifies that a user can switch between desktop and mobile preview sizes on the session dashboard.

steps.description: Toggle the preview to the mobile size
Toggle the preview back to the desktop size
Verify the preview reflects the selected size mode

title: Update CMS site settings and save them
description: A user can modify CMS site settings from the dashboard and confirm the saved configuration is reflected in the interface.

steps.description: Verify the updated CMS settings are visible after saving

title: Open the public gallery from the homepage
description: This verifies that a visitor can view the public gallery of recent sessions from the homepage.

steps.description: Verify recent public sessions are displayed

title: Open the embedded CMS studio from the dashboard
description: A user can open the embedded Sanity studio from the session dashboard and manage content in the embedded studio view.

steps.description: Verify the embedded studio is displayed
